answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A zephyr of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pearl of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
